title: cms: implement dissection for the Algorithm Identifier Protection Attribute

notes.body:
Hi @SpecLad, merge request builds are currently failing with

```
FAILED: epan/dissectors/asn1/cms/cms-exp.cnf /builds/wireshark/wireshark/build/epan/dissectors/asn1/cms/cms-exp.cnf 
cd /builds/wireshark/wireshark/build/epan/dissectors/asn1/cms && /builds/wireshark/wireshark/.venv/bin/python3 /builds/wireshark/wireshark/tools/asn2wrs.py -E -b -C -q -L -p cms -c /builds/wireshark/wireshark/epan/dissectors/asn1/cms/cms.cnf -D /builds/wireshark/wireshark/epan/dissectors/asn1/cms CryptographicMessageSyntax.asn AttributeCertificateVersion1.asn CMSFirmwareWrapper.asn CMSAlgorithmProtectionAttribute.asn
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/builds/wireshark/wireshark/tools/asn2wrs.py", line 8283, in <module>
    asn2wrs_main()
  File "/builds/wireshark/wireshark/tools/asn2wrs.py", line 8211, in asn2wrs_main
    ast.extend(yacc.parse(data, lexer=lexer, debug=pd))
               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/builds/wireshark/wireshark/tools/yacc.py", line 290, in parse
    return self.parseopt_notrack(input, lexer, debug, tracking, tokenfunc)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/builds/wireshark/wireshark/tools/yacc.py", line 1158, in parseopt_notrack
    tok = call_errorfunc(self.errorfunc, errtoken, self)
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/builds/wireshark/wireshark/tools/yacc.py", line 149, in call_errorfunc
    r = errorfunc(token)
        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/builds/wireshark/wireshark/tools/asn2wrs.py", line 7995, in p_error
    raise ParseError(t, input_file)
ParseError: CMSAlgorithmProtectionAttribute.asn:36: Unexpected token UCASE_IDENT('TYPE')
../../../../../epan/dissectors/asn1/p1/p1.cnf:175: UserWarning: Could not set type of class member EXTENSION.&&absent to _VariableTypeValueSetFieldSpec
  &absent			_VariableTypeValueSetFieldSpec
```

can you take a look?

That's odd... I only see that happening in !19224. Is there some kind of non-determinism in `asn2wrs.py`? It doesn't happen on my machine either.

In principle, it should be enough to comment out the definition of `aa-cmsAlgorithmProtection`. But since I can't reproduce the problem, I don't know for sure if that would do it.
It's happening in !18774 as well. I can reproduce it here on macOS + Python 3.13.0 when building the asn1 target.
Ah, I think it might be because `x509if-exp.cnf` is not listed in `EXPORT_DEPENDS` in `cms/CMakeLists.txt`. So the order that the files are generated in is wrong sometimes.
Could you try with the patch in !19226?

changes_data.diff:
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+-- Extracted from RFC 6211
+
+CMSAlgorithmProtectionAttribute
+  { iso(1) member-body(2) us(840) rsadsi(113549)
+    pkcs(1) pkcs-9(9) smime(16) modules(0)
+    id-mod-cms-algorithmProtect(52) }
+DEFINITIONS IMPLICIT TAGS ::=
+BEGIN
+ IMPORTS
+
+   -- Cryptographic Message Syntax (CMS) [CMS]
+
+   DigestAlgorithmIdentifier, MessageAuthenticationCodeAlgorithm,
+   SignatureAlgorithmIdentifier
+   FROM  CryptographicMessageSyntax
+     { iso(1) member-body(2) us(840) rsadsi(113549)
+       pkcs(1) pkcs-9(9) smime(16) modules(0) id-mod-cms-2004-02(41) }
+
+   -- Common PKIX structures [RFC5912]
+
+   ATTRIBUTE
+   FROM PKIX-CommonTypes-2009
+     { iso(1) identified-organization(3) dod(6) internet(1)
+       security(5) mechanisms(5) pkix(7) id-mod(0)
+       id-mod-pkixCommon-02(57)};
+
+   --
+   --  The CMS Algorithm Protection attribute is a Signed Attribute or
+   --  an Authenticated Attribute.
+   --
+   --  Add this attribute to SignedAttributesSet in [CMS]
+   --  Add this attribute to AuthAttributeSet in [CMS]
+   --
+
+   aa-cmsAlgorithmProtection ATTRIBUTE ::= {
+      TYPE CMSAlgorithmProtection
+      IDENTIFIED BY { id-aa-cmsAlgorithmProtect }
+   }
+
+   id-aa-cmsAlgorithmProtect OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= {
+      iso(1) member-body(2) us(840) rsadsi(113549) pkcs(1)
+      pkcs9(9) 52 }
+
+   CMSAlgorithmProtection ::= SEQUENCE {
+      digestAlgorithm         DigestAlgorithmIdentifier,
+      signatureAlgorithm  [1] SignatureAlgorithmIdentifier OPTIONAL,
+      macAlgorithm        [2] MessageAuthenticationCodeAlgorithm
+                                        OPTIONAL
+   }
+   (WITH COMPONENTS { signatureAlgorithm PRESENT,
+                      macAlgorithm ABSENT } |
+    WITH COMPONENTS { signatureAlgorithm ABSENT,
+                      macAlgorithm PRESENT })
+
+END

@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@ set( ASN_FILE_LIST
 	CryptographicMessageSyntax.asn
 	AttributeCertificateVersion1.asn
 	CMSFirmwareWrapper.asn
+	CMSAlgorithmProtectionAttribute.asn
 )
 
 set( EXTRA_DIST

@@ -120,6 +120,9 @@ FirmwarePackageLoadError		    B "1.2.840.113549.1.9.16.1.18"	"id-ct-firmwareLoad
 HardwareModuleName		          B "1.3.6.1.5.5.7.8.4"	          "id-on-hardwareModuleName"
 FirmwarePackageMessageDigest		B "1.2.840.113549.1.9.16.2.41"	"id-aa-fwPkgMessageDigest"
 
+# RFC 6211 Attribute (in CMSAlgorithmProtectionAttribute.asn)
+CMSAlgorithmProtection  B "1.2.840.113549.1.9.52" "id-aa-cmsAlgorithmProtect"
+
 #.NO_EMIT
 
 #.TYPE_RENAME
